tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang chos kyi grags pas kha'u'i brag sgor gsung brtag gnang ba'i brtag yig bzhugs// yos lo hor zla bdun pa'i tshes bcu gnyis kyi nyin/ mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang chos kyi grags pas skyed lhas kha'u'i brag sgor thugs dam zab rgyas bskang gso dang bcas brtag bsgril gnang ba la/ 'di thon pa yin/ dus rgyun par dge ba ci byas pa rnams sdig bshags su dmigs shing bla ma yi dam chos skyong dbyer med la gsol ba rtse gcig tu btab pa'i mthus rang nyid skye ba phyi ma bde ba can du skye nges pas bzang ngo / ༈ 'di thon pa yin/ rang gi slob ma nye 'khor 'di rnams sdig bshags smon lam nged rang gis byas pa'i mthus skye ba phyi ma rang dang lhan cig bde ba can du skye nges pas bzang / ༈ 'di thog mar thon pa yin/ rang nyid bde ba can du skye ba'i gegs kyi sgrib sbyong la dmigs nas ma ṇi dung lnga dang / oṃ gsum ma bye bsnyen gcig dang / lha sar skor ba 'bum ther rnams gzhan la yon sprad nas byed bcug na rang nyid tshe 'phos 'phral bde ba can du skye nges pas bzang / 'di rjes su thon pa yin/ rang nyid bde ba can du skye ba'i gegs kyi sgrib sbyong la dmigs nas ma ṇi dung lnga/ oṃ gsum ma bye bsnyen gcig lha sar skor ba 'bum ther sogs de rnams gang rigs gcig gzhan la yon sprad nas byed bcug na rang nyid tshe 'phos phral bde ba can du skye nges pas bzang / ༈ 'di ma thon pa yin/ /dus rgyun par dge ba ci byas pa rnams sdig bshags su dmigs shing bla ma yi dam chos skyong dbyer med la gsol ba rtse gcig tu btab pa'i mthus rang nyid skye ba phyi ma bde ba can du mi skye bas ngan/ ༈ 'di ma thon pa yin/ rang gi slob ma nye 'khor 'di rnams sdig bshags smon lam nged rang gis byas kyang re zhig rang dang lhan cig bde ba can du mi skye bas ngan/

༈ 'di ma thon pa yin/ rang nyid bde ba can du skye ba'i gegs kyi sgrib sbyong la dmigs nas ma ṇi dung lnga dang / oṃ gsum ma bye bsnyen gcig dang / lha sar skor ba 'bum ther rnams gzhan la yon sprad nas byed bcug kyang rang nyid skye ba kha shas bde ba can du mi skye bas ngan/ sa skya pa kun dga' bsod nams kyi brjed tho'o// bkra shis/ ༈ /byi lo lho rong du chings la phyin dus/ nged rang la med thabs med pa'i rab 'byams pa de nyid 'das par brten/ gdan sar 'byor 'phral sgo rum ye shes mgon po'i drung du lung bstan zhus pa'i brtag yig la/ ༈ /rab 'byams pa bsod nams 'od zer dkon mchog gi thugs rje dang smon lam rten 'brel byin rlabs kyis/ da lta mkha' spyod chung ngu'i go 'phang thob yod nges pas bzang ngo / ༈ /drung rab pa bsod nams 'od zer dkon mchog gi thugs rje dang smon lam rten 'brel byin rlabs kyis da lta bde ba can du skyes yod nges pas bzang ngo / ༈ /drung rab pa bsod nams 'od zer da lta rigs drug gang rigs su skyes yod cing / skye ba lnga drug brgyud nas de mtshams rnam grol thob pas bzang / ༈ /rab 'byams pa bsod nams 'od zer da lta rigs drug gang rigs su skyes yod cing / de 'phos 'phral dkon mchog gi thugs rje dang / smon lam rten 'brel byin rlabs kyis mkha' spyod dam bde ba can du skye nges pas bzang / 'di rnams ye shes mgon po la gsol ba rtse gcig tu btab nas brtag sgril byas pas/ rtag yig snga ma 'di gnyis nged rang gi pang du cab kyis thon/ gzhan rnams ma thon byung pas/ bla ma dkon mchog gi thugs rje dang / chos skyong gi nus mthu/ nged rang gnyis lhag bsam dag par brten dag pa'i zhing du gtan du bde ba'i btsan sa zin nges par 'dug snyam/ de nub nas gnyid khugs pa lta bu'i blo bde ba'i tshad du byung zhing / phyis nas rim gyis brtags pas kyang nges shes 'grong du rang song pa zhig byung pa skyabs gnas bslu med rnams kyi thugs rjer go

༈ /zur khang gi rje btsun rin po che'i sku 'dra'i drung du brtag pa byas pas kyang bde ba can du skyes zer ba thon/ gzhan rnams ma thon pa yin/ gzhan yang rtags mang du byung ngo // //bkra shis// ༈ mkhan chen a pad rin po che'i dgongs bzhed ltar gu rus zhabs zhu bgyis pa'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 a myes zhabs/ mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags pas kha'u'i brag sgor gsung brtag gnang ba'i brtag yig PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
